articles.title: Michael Saylor’s Strategy is now tracking bitcoin’s 200-week moving average
articles.snippet: Michael Saylor’s company, Strategy, is now closely monitoring bitcoin’s 200-week moving average, a key long-term support level that the cryptocurrency has historically respected.

articles.title: Strategy holds STRC dividend at 12%
articles.snippet: Customarily, Michael Saylor and team have lifted the STRC dividend when it trades sizably below par, but not this month.
